blurb: Guests take a hot air balloon flight following a unique path over the Sonoran Desert, Tucson Mountains, Saguaro National Park West, and Avra Valley. Flights typically last 1 to 2 hours, covering 10 to 15 miles at altitudes between 500 ft and 4000 ft. After the flight, guests enjoy a continental champagne brunch and receive photos taken by the ground crew.
extraNote: Year-round, seven days a week, weather permitting
